Which breakpoint do you set?

Start from what you already know

Browser DevTools mastery (used in every phase) · 2/4

One type per question

  1. 1Line-of-code: pause on an exact line
  2. 2Conditional: pause on a line only when true
  3. 3Logpoint: log to the Console, no pause
  4. 4DOM change: pause on code that changes a node
  5. 5XHR/fetch: pause when a URL has a string
  6. 6Event listener: pause on code after an event

Browser DevTools mastery (used in every phase) · 3/4

Three ways to step

The function is related

  • Step into: pause inside it

The function is not related

  • Step over: run it whole
  • Step out: finish it and return

Resume runs until the next breakpoint.
